text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health (TPH) Capital Budget Variance for the twelve months ended on December 31, 2019. As of December 31, 2019, TPH spent $3.852 million, representing 79.2 percent of the 2019 Approved Capital Budget of $4.865 million.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (May 29, 2020) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
